connector.name: Carso Exchange Engine
connector.registryDescription: AI-native platform: cybernetic freight agents transact, verify, find services. Get verified leads.
connector.summary: Hosted at engine.carso.exchange over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace exchange.carso. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api_key>; key format cxk_<key_id>.<secret>. Obtain per-agent keys via an operator: https://engine.carso.exchange/docs/auth
